integrity: The finite theorem is established by exhaustive exact integer arithmetic on prime-exponent vectors. Equality of primitive Pluecker coordinates is used only for independent pairs and is equivalent to equality of their rational two-planes; every enumerated triangle is rechecked after translation by \(1\). The verifier also reproduces the published count of \(13\) unordered triples through \(1000\) and checks explicit relations for the two boundary witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite cutoff through \(H=1215\). It neither proves unboundedness of \(M(H)\) nor determines later jumps. The Benelux pair \((75,1215)\) is prior work; only the triple-counting boundary and exhaustive exclusion through \(1214\) are claimed. Unindexed computations remain a residual bibliographic risk.
title: The first post-1000 jump of \(M(H)\) occurs at \(H=1215\)
